input.read_mode: immutable SourceByteSnapshot; NPZ size preflight before numpy.load

limitations: synthetic input only; no Wilson measurement or production source bytes were read
the repository has no raw cross-correlator producer; diagonal loop arrays cannot reconstruct missing off-diagonal elements
synthetic block spread is descriptive and is not a confidence interval or independence claim
captured-byte digest equality does not authenticate who issued the expected digests
no state-overlap/gap fit, q upper bound, coverage calibration, finite-Nt backward term, thermal h, mixed x, force propagation, or physical gate

method.gevp: C(td)v=lambda C(t0)v; largest eigenvalue vector, C(t0)-normalized
method.operator_matrix: C_ij(R,t)=<O_i(R,t) O_j^dagger(R,0)>; i is sink and j is source
method.output: projected block correlators and condition diagnostics only; no fit/q/interval
method.projection: v^dagger C_block(R,t) v using one ensemble-mean vector per operator/R cell

toy_model.temporal_extent: finite metadata, but synthetic input contains forward terms only
toy_model.variation: deterministic small block-dependent overlap/energy perturbations; no stochastic noise model
